intended_use: Replace FAQ-backed Article 26 baseline rate evidence, with covered-income and non-PE scope preserved.
limits: 20 percent is a statutory baseline, not every outbound payment effective rate.
Article 26(1b) permits reduced interest rates by Government Regulation.
Treaty entitlement remains conditional; PMK112/2025 migration is separate.
2022 compilation requires subsequent-amendment verification before current-law approval.

later_official_consolidation.visual_findings: Article26(1) baseline20 percent gross for listed payments to nonresident non-PE recipients; Article26(1a) beneficial-owner residence; Article26(1b) reduced interest rate possible by Government Regulation; Article26(2) uses deemed net rather than gross. Footer identifies amendment references through Law6/2023.

subsequent_instrument_review.finding: PP20/2026 recitals still identify Income Tax Law last amended by Law6/2023; this instrument amends PP55/2022, including nondeductible bribery expenditures and small-turnover income rules. This supports using the 2023 consolidation as a later legislative source but does not independently certify every 2026 exception.
subsequent_instrument_review.review_scope: Read opening amendment frame and recitals, not a complete current-law approval.

registration_plan.effective_date_policy: Do not give entire consolidated book one inferred enactment date; statute amendments and per-parameter applicability require independent dates.
registration_plan.current_build: Vietnam distribution build completed and seven-table parity verified before this catalog registration.

parser_review.observed_failure: Generic single-act slicer produced only 40 article groups from the multi-act book and did not provide the reviewed uppercase PASAL 26 page locator.
parser_review.repair: Document-specific original page slicing; 426 original pages, 425 nonempty page citations with blank-page numbering preserved.
parser_review.validation: All nonempty extracted page texts match their original page exactly after outer whitespace trimming. All 76 database tests passed in 12.16 seconds.
parser_review.scope: Parser prepared; document catalog registration and primary-law parameter migration still pending. No current-law approval inferred.

registered_document.title: Susunan Dalam Satu Naskah Undang-Undang Perpajakan Edisi 2023
registered_document.note: Official 2023 multi-act consolidation including amendments through Law6/2023. Original PDF page locators preserve separate acts and commentary; no single enactment date applies to the entire book. Article26(1) at PDF242 provides the listed nonresident non-PE payment baseline, not every effective outbound rate; later amendments, treaty entitlement and payment-specific exceptions require separate review.

source_candidate_review.visual_review: Both original pages visually inspected. Page242 contains Article26(1),(1a),(1b),(2) and start of (2a), plus separate prior-article commentary. Page243 continues (2a), includes (3),(4),(5) and separately boxed Article26 explanation. Native extraction order differs from visual order; full page content and boundaries preserved.
source_candidate_review.scope: Source text admission candidate only; no approval of every 2026 exception, treaty entitlement, or legacy final-tax generalization.
